tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Director, in coordination with appropriate Federal authorities, shall—

children.text: as appropriate, ensure coordination of Federal agencies engaged in the development of international technical standards related to information system security; and
not later than 1 year after December 18, 2014, develop and transmit to Congress a plan for ensuring such Federal agency coordination.

tree.heading: Consultation with the private sector
tree.text: In carrying out the activities specified in subsection (a)(1), the Director shall ensure consultation with appropriate private sector stakeholders.
